question: I became even more attached to Sylphy in Season 3, but is there any character that you became more attached to after he/she was voiced in the anime?
answer: The Sin Archbishops. The Sin Archbishops were characterized as having “not a single good thing about them,” but when Regulus and Rye appeared in the first episode of Season 2, episode 26, I said, “All The Sin Archbishops have great voices!” (lol). Even though everyone talks for so long, they have such great voices that it’s easy to listen to them. Unfortunately, that’s it for Regulus-san. He talked enough, though! And the characters that were voiced in Season 3, I originally liked them of course, but I became more attached to them. Liliana had to be cast based on the premise of singing, and I wondered what they would do with her…. Also, Heinkel was great.
